description: Read an X-ray. Pass requestId to poll a grade started with sightglass_xray (a finished request is billed when first read). Pass adId or sitePageId to read the grade itself: scores, findings and fixes, as far as the workspace has unlocked it. A target nobody has graded returns its summary with the grade locked; offer to run sightglass_xray. Returns data only: nothing is shown to the user yet. Once you know the answer, call sightglass_show once with this call's resultId to show it as cards; the show call does not search again.

adId.description: Grade this ad together with its landing page, as a funnel.

projectId.description: Replo project id, from list_projects: where the charge or the asset lands. Its workspace's plan applies.

requestId.description: A request id from sightglass_xray: returns its status. Pass this instead of a target while a grade is running.

workspaceId.description: Replo workspace id, from list_workspaces. Sets which workspace's plan applies; required when the user has more than one workspace.

name: sightglass_get_xray
title: Get X-ray
